items.title: The Fitting ideals of the sheaf of differentials commute with base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> S locally of finite type with Z_i the closed subschemes defined by the Fitting ideals of Omega_{X/S}, the formation of the Z_i commutes with arbitrary base change (source lines 1569-1576). The proof notes that Omega_{X/S} is a finite type quasi-coherent module so that the Fitting ideals are defined, uses compatibility of differentials with base change to identify Omega_{X'/S'} with the pullback of Omega_{X/S}, and concludes that the pullback of Fit_i(Omega_{X/S}) generates Fit_i(Omega_{X'/S'}), which says exactly that Z'_i = Z_i x_X X' scheme theoretically.
